witness_verification: For every n>=1, the full cube has positive teaching dimension infinity because its empty concept has no positive teaching set, while its positive recursive teaching dimension is n. Thus the gap is unbounded.
name: Positive Teaching Dimension / Positive Recursive Teaching Dimension
proof: A positive teacher that distinguishes every target in the full class can be used at the first recursive stage.  Recursive removal can only reduce the set of competitors, so the positive recursive optimum is no larger.
